autofarm.config.title: AutoFarm Settings
autofarm.config.range.tooltip: Horizontal radius around the player to look for crops to harvest. Only loaded chunks are searched.
autofarm.config.vertical_range.tooltip: How far above and below the player to look for crops and farmland (harvesting and planting).
autofarm.config.action_delay.tooltip: Ticks to wait between harvest / plant actions (20 ticks = 1 second). Raise it if a server rejects actions.
autofarm.config.only_mature.tooltip: When off, crops that are still growing are harvested too.
autofarm.config.replant.tooltip: Plant a seed from your inventory where a crop was harvested (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, cocoa, ...).
autofarm.config.highlight.tooltip: Preview which crops will be harvested with glowing green boxes, even while not farming. While planting, empty farmland is marked blue. Turn off to hide all boxes.
autofarm.config.through_walls.tooltip: Draw highlights and the path on top of blocks.
autofarm.config.show_path.tooltip: Draw the path to the next target as a line.
autofarm.config.pickup.tooltip:
Walk over to dropped items after harvesting.
My Harvest: drops from crops this mod harvested
All Crops: any crop / seed item lying in range
autofarm.config.plant_range.tooltip: Horizontal radius in which empty farmland is planted when pressing Home.
autofarm.config.motion.tooltip:
Machine: harvests everything within reach right away, snaps the camera and walks at full speed.
Human: walks slowly up to 1-2 blocks from each crop and turns the camera smoothly onto it. Where it looks, how fast it walks and the pauses between actions vary a little.
autofarm.config.sprint.tooltip: Machine motion: sprint to crops that are far away (6+ blocks), walk the last few blocks. Needs more than 3 hunger.
autofarm.config.run_in_menus.tooltip:
Keep walking and harvesting while chat, the Esc menu, settings etc. are open. Inventories / chests still pause it.
In singleplayer the Esc menu pauses the whole game; open the world to LAN to keep it running.
autofarm.config.skip_stuck.tooltip:
If a crop won't come off (blocked by the server, takes too long, ...), try it as many times as set below, then leave that spot alone for 2 minutes and move on.
Off: old behaviour.
autofarm.config.retries.tooltip: How many times to try a crop that won't come off, and to replant a spot that stays empty after replanting.
autofarm.config.crops.tooltip: Choose which crops the Delete / End keys harvest.
autofarm.config.seeds.tooltip: Choose which seeds the Home key plants on empty farmland. With several selected, they are used in list order, whichever you carry. Nether wart goes on soul sand.
